title: Jebel-Quant Fleet (public)
description: Public copy of the fleet board. Public repos only, and nothing about any particular working copy - the collector runs with JQ_PUBLIC_ONLY and the local-clone panels are stripped from this copy.

panels.title: Open PRs
panels.description: Open pull requests across the fleet, counted before any per-repo clipping.

panels.title: Open issues
panels.description: Open issues across the fleet, excluding pull requests - GitHub's own open_issues_count lumps the two together, so PRs are subtracted out.

panels.title: CI red on main
panels.description: Repos whose last completed run on the default branch did not pass.

panels.title: Data age
panels.description: How long since the collector last refreshed, worst of its two sources. This machine's Docker pauses when the Mac sleeps, so nothing is collected then - an amber or red value here means the numbers above are from before the last sleep, and panels can read 'No data' entirely once the gap passes Prometheus's 5-minute staleness window.

panels.title: Open problems by kind
panels.description: How many repos are in each bad state over time. Three distinct kinds, so the colours carry identity, not severity.

panels.title: Last completed run on the default branch

targets.expr: (time() - jq_pull_request_created_timestamp_seconds) * on(repo, number) group_left(title, author, checks, draft) topk by (repo, number) (1, jq_pull_request_info)

value.title: Open this pull request on GitHub
Open this pull request on GitHub
Open the repo's pull requests on GitHub

panels.title: Recently merged pull requests
panels.description: The ten most recent merges across the whole fleet. Closed-but-abandoned pull requests are excluded - only ones that actually landed appear here.

panels.title: Failing workflows on the default branch
panels.description: One row per failing workflow, not per repo - a repo can have more than one red workflow, so this list can be longer than the 'CI red on main' tile, which counts repos.

panels.title: Repos behind the template
panels.description: Every repo pinned to an older template release. Matches the 'Behind template' tile.

panels.title: Open pull requests with red checks
panels.description: Matches the 'PRs with red checks' tile.

targets.expr: (time() - jq_pull_request_created_timestamp_seconds) * on(repo, number) group_left(title, author, checks) topk by (repo, number) (1, jq_pull_request_info{checks=~"failure|cancelled"})

panels.title: Open issues by repo
panels.description: Repos with at least one open issue, pull requests excluded.

panels.title: Behind template
panels.description: Repos pinned to a template release older than the newest one.

panels.title: Template releases behind
panels.description: How many releases were published after each repo's pinned ref. Repos pinned to a branch or a sha are absent - the pin is not comparable to a release.
